name: W Austin
insider_take: The W Austin pulses with the electric energy of the Live Music Capital of the World, perfectly positioned where downtown's corporate towers meet the legendary Sixth Street entertainment district.
whats_special: This sleek tower is Austin's tallest hotel and the only W property in Texas, featuring a rooftop pool deck with panoramic city views and direct access to ACL Live at The Moody Theater. The hotel's WET Deck overlooks Lady Bird Lake, while ground-level restaurants connect seamlessly to the bustling Second Street District's upscale shopping and dining scene.
pro_tip: Book a lake-view room on floors 25+ for stunning sunrise views over Lady Bird Lake and the perfect vantage point to watch Austin City Limits performances from your window.
dont_miss: The Thursday night Whatever/Whenever poolside parties, sunset cocktails at the WET Deck with live DJ sets, and the short walk to catch world-class performances at ACL Live - you can literally stumble from your room to see major touring acts without stepping outside.
pros: Prime downtown location in Austin's entertainment district
Vibrant nightlife scene with rooftop pools and bars
Modern luxury amenities and stylish design
Live music venue and cultural programming
cons: High-energy party atmosphere may not suit all travelers
